// PROBE: compliant — reads every real channel but collapses delivery rows to
// events through the sanctioned helper. The scanner must accept this.
import { groupNotificationEventRows } from "@/lib/notifications/event-grouping"
export async function getHistory(db: any, userId: string) {
    const rows = await db.notificationEvent.findMany({
        where: { userId, channel: { not: "analytics" } },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    })
    return groupNotificationEventRows(rows)
}
